name: session-pane
description: Status pane for the current session: goal, status/progress, steps, jump-to-message buttons, next-prompt copy, work folders and a fix-later list. No model calls; merges into the opencode-sidebar Session pane when present.

hostPane.title: Host pane
hostPane.description: Pane id fragment of another plugin's pane to merge into (the opencode-sidebar Session pane by default). Leave empty to always open a separate pane.

hideHostSections.title: Hide host sections
hideHostSections.description: Comma-separated section headings to drop from the host pane while merged, e.g. "Recent,Cache". Empty keeps the host pane as is.

watchRoots.title: Watched folders (relative)
watchRoots.description: Comma-separated folders under the session cwd whose new or edited files show as work products.

extraRoots.title: Watched folders (absolute)
extraRoots.description: Comma-separated absolute folders (a work folder outside the repo, for example C:/Work) whose files also show as work products.
